title: Charleroi, Hainaut — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Charleroi, Hainaut: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Charleroi is a city in Hainaut with a population of 201,000. A city in transformation with Belgium’s lowest housing costs, a growing creative scene, and excellent air connectivity via Brussels South Airport. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
